description: This file contains the implementation of a ColumnIterator class used to iterate over columns in a worksheet within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It implements the native PHP Iterator interface and provides methods to navigate through columns, reset start/end points, and access current column details.

classes.name: ColumnIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing columns in a worksheet, allowing iteration from a start to an end column, with methods to seek, reset, and navigate through columns.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the column iterator with a worksheet and optional start and end columns.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor safely nullifies the worksheet reference.

methods.name: resetStart
methods.description: Resets the starting column for iteration and the current position.

methods.name: resetEnd
methods.description: Resets the ending column for iteration.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Sets the current iterator position to a specified column.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the start column.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current Column object at the iterator's position.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the string identifier of the current column.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next column.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous column.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position is within the specified range of columns.
